The '''''Teyr''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], it shipped 50 [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] to the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].
